combo_label: The Pub × Camping & the Outdoors × Mr Men & Little Miss

entries.clue: Ten fluid ounces of beer, the measure a driver settles for
Spring-gated metal loop joining a climber to the rope
Two-berth box towed behind the family car to the coast
Field worker whose name labels a plate of cheese, bread and pickle
Diminutive Mr Men chap; also the size of drink below a medium
Little Miss who will not budge an inch; mule-headed and set in her ways
Brimming with questions, or else oddly hard to explain
Hargreaves' blobby little fellows, taken all together as a brand
Cross the fields all afternoon at your leisure, or let a story go on and on
Malt goes in, hops go in, and beer runs out of the works
Brass fitting on the bar counter that the draught beer flows from
